hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI reflects Nel's strategic investment in industrial-scale electrolyzer production capacity, marking a technological and industrial turning point for the company, aligned with future green hydrogen demand.

kpis.name: Orders Received
kpis.explanation: Value of new orders signed during the year.
kpis.description: The 40 MW order for HYDS is the largest PEM order in Nel's history and the second largest by value.
kpis.signal: Record 40 MW PEM order, historic level.

kpis.name: Production Capacity
kpis.description: Completed investment to create 1 gigawatt of production capacity for the new pressurized alkaline platform.
kpis.signal: Key investment decision for 1 GW at Herøya.

kpis.name: R&D Progress
kpis.explanation: Development level of new electrolysis platforms.
kpis.description: PEM and pressurized alkaline programs progressed substantially in 2025, with successful testing and commercial launch planned for 2026.
kpis.signal: PEM and pressurized alkaline platforms in final phase.

kpis.name: Strategic Partnership
kpis.explanation: Key collaboration with a major industrial player.
kpis.description: Signature of a strategic EPC partnership with SAMSUNG E&A, which also becomes the main sole shareholder.

kpis.name: FEED Activity
kpis.explanation: Activity level in preliminary hydrogen project studies.
kpis.description: FEED activity level remained elevated in 2025, indicating sustained interest in large-scale projects.
kpis.signal: High FEED activity despite commercial slowdown.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue declined in 2025 due to delays in investment decisions and project milestone slippages.

kpis.name: Cash Position
kpis.description: Cash position remained solid in 2025 thanks to early cost reduction and production capacity optimization.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 4.96 billion EUR in latest year

kpis.name: 1 GW Capacity Decision
kpis.explanation: Investment in a 1 GW factory for the new pressurized alkaline technology.
kpis.description: Final investment decision made in 2025 for 1 GW of capacity at Herøya, supported by the European Innovation Fund.

kpis.name: PEM Order Growth
kpis.explanation: Progression of orders for PEM electrolyzers.
kpis.description: The 40 MW order for HYDS marks acceleration in PEM order intake in 2025.

risks.title: Dependence on a Limited Number of Key Suppliers
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly identified in Item 1A as dependence on third-party suppliers for critical components. Moderate language but mitigation strategy (dual supply chains) indicates substantial concern. Trend stable but high weight for supply chain in rapid growth phase.

risks.title: Technology Obsolescence Risk and Competitive Technological Risk
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned: 'Other technologies under development could potentially make renewable hydrogen less relevant' and 'if competitors gain advantages in alternative electrolyser technologies'. Moderate alert language but emerging market context with rapid growth amplifies risk. Trend up due to intensifying competition (notably China).

risks.title: Product Failure Risk and Technology Obsolescence
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly identified: 'increased risk related to product failure and technology obsolescence' with direct reputational impact ('reputational damage risk from product failure'). Clear alert language. High weight as affects technology eligibility with customers. Trend stable but growing concern in commercialization phase.

risks.title: Dependence on Government Incentives and Subsidy Reduction Risk
risks.score_rationale: Major risk explicitly highlighted: 'Reduced and/or delayed support from governments will delay the developments' and 'Political incentive schemes are expected to be important contributors'. Strong alert language with direct pipeline impact. Trend up: document cites 'Delays in and cancellations of announced government incentives' already reducing order intake.

risks.title: Customer Concentration Risk and Dependence on Customer Commercial Success
risks.score_rationale: Identified in Item 1A: 'Nel's ability to grow depends to a substantial degree on its ability to successfully win new customers' and risk that customers may not achieve their commercial plans. Moderate language but direct growth impact. Trend stable but slowed market context increases criticality.

risks.title: Commercial Validation Risk for New Technology Platforms
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned: 'the development and roll out of new technology platforms require commercial validation' and 'a transitional period with continued risk-mitigation is expected until performance and cost assumptions are proven at scale'. Clear alert language. High weight as affects future business model viability.

risks.title: Market Slowdown Risk and Slower Than Expected Deployment
risks.score_rationale: Major risk documented: 'Deployment has been slower than expected, with project cancellations, delays and fewer final investment decisions'. Strong alert language with direct pipeline impact. Trend up: document cites smaller-than-expected projects and structural challenges identified by the IEA.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risk and Operational Data Protection
risks.score_rationale: Identified as material in double materiality assessment alongside innovation and R&D topics. Moderate language but explicit recognition as sustainability risk. Trend stable but growing weight for manufacturing company operating globally.

ai_positioning.summary: Nel ASA makes no mention of artificial intelligence use or strategy in its 2025 annual report.
evidence: No mention of AI in technology, R&D or strategy sections.
Innovations centered on energy efficiency and operational cost reduction.
No reference to AI tools for design, maintenance or operations.
